newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends slightly lower in modest trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends slightly lower in modest trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed slightly down against its U.S. counterpart on Tuesday as importers' year-end demand started to emerge, dealers said.
The local unit closed at T$27.497 against Monday's T$27.495 end. Turnover was a modest US$171 million.

The American currency's strength overseas also triggered U.S. dollar buying, pulling the local unit to T$27.499 at one stage, but local banks' late U.S. dollar sales offset the Taiwan dollar's fall, dealers said "The rate will continue to move around a narrow T$27.49-50 range unless something significant emerges," said one dealer. -- Alice Hung (2-5080815)
